claim: A statement of work filed with the U.S. Justice Department under the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA) — the 1938 law requiring anyone acting in the United States for a foreign government to register and publish the terms of the work — commits Clock Tower LLC, the firm owned by former Trump campaign manager Brad Parscale, to the "Deployment of websites and content to deliver GPT framing results on GPT conversations." GPT is the model family behind ChatGPT. The line sits under "Search and Language Operations" alongside monthly search-engine-optimization targets, in an initial statement of work between Havas Media Germany GmbH and Clock Tower dated August 2025 and filed September 18, 2025. The same document describes the engagement as support for "Client's engagement by the State of Israel to develop and execute a nationwide campaign in the United States to combat antisemitism," sets a combined budget pool of $1,500,000 per month for four months, and requires 5,000 monthly creative variants with at least 80 percent of content tailored to Gen Z audiences on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and podcasts.
